title: Miura-ori
description: A 4×4 Miura-ori. Pull two corners and the whole sheet collapses at once.

steps.title: Horizontal pleats
steps.instruction: Crease the three horizontal quarter lines as valleys.

steps.title: Zig-zag 1
tips: Each segment slants the other way from the last.

steps.title: Zig-zag 2
tips: Each segment slants the other way from the last.

steps.title: Zig-zag 3
tips: Each segment slants the other way from the last.

steps.title: Reverse segments
steps.instruction: Re-crease alternate row segments as mountains.
tips: Each row alternates mountain, valley along its length.

steps.title: Collapse
tips: Rigid-foldable: all creases move at once.
mistakes: Folding one row at a time.
